properties.headline: Flood Advisory issued October 22 at 6:48PM PDT until October 22 at 8:30PM PDT by NWS Hanford CA
properties.description:
* WHAT...Flooding caused by excessive rainfall continues.

* WHERE...Northeastern Merced County in central California...

* WHEN...Until 830 PM PDT.

* IMPACTS...Minor flooding in low-lying and poor drainage areas.
Water over roadways.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...
- At 645 PM PDT, Doppler radar indicated heavy rain due to
thunderstorms. Minor flooding is ongoing or expected to begin
shortly in the advisory area. Between 1 and 1.5 inches of rain
have fallen so far.
- Additional rainfall amounts up to 0.5 inches are expected over
the area. This additional rain will result in minor flooding. The
California Highway Patrol has reported roadway flooding near
Merced.
- Some locations that will experience flooding include...
Merced and Planada.
- http://www.weather.gov/safety/flood
properties.instruction:
Turn around, don't drown when encountering flooded roads. Most flood
deaths occur in vehicles.

NWSheadline: FLOOD ADVISORY REMAINS IN EFFECT UNTIL 830 PM PDT THIS EVENING
